title: Cast Iron vs. PVC in DWV Systems
description: Selecting the right material for Drain, Waste, and Vent (DWV) systems depends on acoustic requirements, fire ratings, and installation conditions. Cast iron offers superior sound attenuation due to its high mass and density, making it ideal for multi-family residential waste stacks where falling water noise must be minimized. Schedule 40 PVC is lightweight, highly resistant to chemical corrosion, and economical to assemble using solvent cement. Understanding material performance characteristics ensures compliance with local structural codes, fire containment rules, and sound isolation requirements.
